$Comment: Deep Freeze, the Ice Focus's signature: an Ice hit (where the Ice damage line counts) has a 15% chance to freeze its foe solid for 1 second (the game's Ability_Frost_Freeze, in the Frozen family, a Stun to a boss's rules, so a boss or an elite shrugs it), each foe at most once every 10 seconds. Its freeze waits per foe like every control: an Immune foe is passed over, it is shorter each time on a foe frozen again soon, and each landing ramps the foe's Immunity. It runs after every talent's proc on the hit (the skeleton's Order), so the hit that freezes a foe never shatters that freeze too. Opens on the Signature step while the Ice Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
